infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Zip Connect uses your camera to take a live photo when you clock in or out, confirming it is you.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Zip Connect lets you choose an existing photo when you upload an identity document or set your profile picture.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Zip Connect checks your location about every 12 minutes while you are clocked in — including when the app is closed — to confirm you are at your assigned store. It stops when your shift ends.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Zip Connect checks your location when you clock in or out, to confirm you are at your assigned store.

plugins.photosPermission: Zip Connect lets you choose an existing photo when you upload an identity document or set your profile picture.
plugins.cameraPermission: Zip Connect uses your camera to photograph your identity documents and to take a live photo when you clock in or out.
